title: The Send to Terminal action needs Invoicing & payments Create & Edit + Customer Portal Enabled
preconds:
1. See Financial Data ON.
  2. User A has Invoicing & payments View only; User B has Invoicing & payments Create & Edit and Customer Portal enabled
steps:
1. As User A, open an unpaid invoice on a work order and look for a Send to Terminal action.
  2. As User B, open the same kind of unpaid invoice and look for Send to Terminal.
  3. Click it and confirm the terminal flow starts.
expected:
Send to Terminal is not shown for User A (View only).

<p>Send to Terminal is shown for User B and starts the terminal payment flow.</p>
